topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I remember the crisp morning when I first saw my words, my thoughts, sprawled across the page in the school's common area. They weren't just any words; they were my college application essay, now an example for others to follow. The sun streamed in through the windows, as if it knew the significance of the moment. Pages that once held just my dreams were now shared, shining a light on the paths less traveled. I felt a gentle pride, as if the morning itself was a reflection of the journey I had embarked upon. Each sentence, crafted with care, seemed to resonate with a purpose larger than the room, larger than myself, inviting others to dream just as boldly.
